description: "Diary from March 4, 1861, to November 12, 1862" by Adam Gurowski is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The work provides a firsthand perspective on the tumultuous period of the American Civil War, chronicling Gurowski's observations and reflections as he witnesses the political and military developments of the time.
